source_contract: Reuse current launcher bootstrap metadata/catalog/update-candidate behavior and prior source-bound specifications; no new protocol fields or REA queries.
ports: Explicit bounded HTTP GET transport using native wx.request arraybuffer and manual redirect on documented platforms
Owned cancellation and monotonic deadline clock ports without DOM globals
Strict portable UTF-8 and complete WHATWG GB18030 catalog decoder with pinned public standard tables
host: Explicit optional remote initialization configuration; no startup auto-request. User load/refresh invalidates credentials, confirmation, choices and previous target; only complete validated catalog pairs become selectable. Update candidates never execute. Hide/cancel ignores late results and aborts owned work.
validation: Original HTTP service and API-shaped fixture, not official network
Full decoder mappings/range boundaries plus invalid sequences and budgets
Actual host/Page events and generated no-DOM bundle
native_gate: IDE_SERVICE_PORT_EXPLICITLY_DISABLED retained; do not retry or modify security settings
remaining: Game business consumer evidence and playable game implementation

configuration.XML_pair: Both strings or, with bootstrap, both null; mixed/null without bootstrap rejected.
configuration.launcher_input: User-chosen file only, bounded read1..32MiB; no EXE/config bytes bundled by default, no execution.
configuration.local_raw_catalog_pair: null/unavailable each load; no persistent cache implemented

limits_and_unknowns: Documented HTTP manual-redirect SDK/platform gates, HTTPS DNS443 only; original HTTP/public-IP game origins are not automatically compatible.
Application byte budgets do not bound native internal IPC/network allocation; no cookies/Fetch credentials equivalence claim.
File APIs have no abort handle; generation/signal stop downstream logic only. Native picker hide behavior unverified.
Two stats do not prove same-size content immutability; MD5 binds actual read bytes but not source authenticity.
WHATWG2022/compatibility decoding is explicit, not an inferred Windows ACP.
No native/phone/WXML/AppID/domain/TLS or official account/game acceptance.
